persons.name: Manokusośarman
persons.evidence: dvija baruttama śrī manokusośarmanasothe likhitedam śāstraṃ

relations.evidence: vijayarāje(!) likhitam idam uḍīsara śāstuṃ ... śrī manokusośarmanasothe likhitedam śāstraṃ

date.as_written: samvat (139) kārttika śukla ----- (viśākha) nakṣatraḥ | āyodhānayogeḥ | ravivāre

place.as_written: mānīsake śrī dakṣiṇe vihāre śrī yotho vihāra

notes: The year is transcribed as (139), but Jayajyotimalla ruled around NS 528–548, meaning the first digit was likely a damaged 5 (NS 539 = 1419 CE). The catalogue identifies Vijayarāja as the scribe based on 'vijayarāje(!) likhitam', although this may be a corruption of 'vijayarājye'. 'manokusośarmanasothe' likely reflects 'manokusośarmaṇas tasyārthe' (or 'manokusumaśarmaṇas tasyārthe'), indicating Manokusośarman as the commissioner.
